verdict.rationale: Remote URL ingestion is a fair question for a speech-to-text API, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only file-upload ingestion: the docs say to upload the audio, the CLI takes a local --file path, and the open-source library transcribes local files. Nothing documents passing a public or signed URL for the service to fetch.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass a public or signed URL and the service fetches and transcribes the recording without my uploading it
